gloss: for young children; aimed at toddlers

definitions.gloss: for young children; aimed at toddlers
definitions.explanation: Describes products, content, services, or activities designed or intended for young children, typically ages one to five. Functions as a noun modifier with の or as a compound modifier before another noun.

examples.japanese: {幼児|ようじ}{向|む}けの{絵本|えほん}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a picture book for young children.

examples.japanese: この{番組|ばんぐみ}は{幼児|ようじ}{向|む}けに{作|つく}られている。
examples.english: This program is made for young children.

examples.japanese: {幼児|ようじ}{向|む}けの{英語|えいご}{教材|きょうざい}は{種類|しゅるい}が{豊富|ほうふ}で、{選|えら}ぶのに{迷|まよ}う。
examples.english: There are so many types of English learning materials for young children that it's hard to choose.

notes:
A compound of {幼児|ようじ} (young child, toddler) and {向|む}け (aimed at, intended for). The {向|む}け suffix is highly productive and can attach to many target audiences: {子供|こども}{向|む}け (for children), {大人|おとな}{向|む}け (for adults), {初心者|しょしんしゃ}{向|む}け (for beginners).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幼児|ようじ}{向|む}けの{絵本|えほん}: picture book for toddlers
- {幼児|ようじ}{向|む}け{番組|ばんぐみ}: children's TV program
- {幼児|ようじ}{向|む}け{教材|きょうざい}: learning materials for young children
- {幼児|ようじ}{向|む}け{食品|しょくひん}: food for young children

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {子供|こども}{向|む}け: for children — broader age range, typically up to elementary school
- {幼児用|ようじよう}: for young children's use — focuses more on physical products (seats, utensils) rather than content
- {乳幼児|にゅうようじ}{向|む}け: for infants and toddlers — includes babies under one year
